what_this_is: A self-audit finding against our own fidelity gate. Check 3, frozen_prompt_repeatability, has been VACUOUS on this model in every run we ever published: it hashed the OpenAI `content` field, Qwen3.8 thinks by default at xhigh effort, and with the probe's 64-token cap the entire budget lands in `reasoning_content`, so `content` came back empty. The check compared eight empty strings and reported PASS.

evidence_of_the_defect.note: completion_tokens was 64 in every row, so the model WAS generating - the text just never reached `content`.

what_is_and_is_not_invalidated.unaffected: Checks 1, 2, 4 and 5 - liveness, generation proof, needle retrieval and MTP sanity - were substantive and did their job. The 262k and 786k needle passes in particular are real evidence and are unchanged. No fidelity conclusion in this project rests on check 3.
what_is_and_is_not_invalidated.invalidated: Any statement that we verified DETERMINISM. We did not. 'Five-check gate PASS' should be read as four substantive checks passing and one contributing no evidence.
what_is_and_is_not_invalidated.cards_corrected: the hydrated card's five-check wording is being amended rather than left to imply more than it proved

fix.vacuity_guard: the check now FAILS outright if every response carried zero content AND zero reasoning, so it can never again pass by comparing nothing

first_result_from_the_fixed_check.endpoint: 8x DP8 at 1M context, UNDER concurrent production load (TB2.1 arm at C16 plus omp)
first_result_from_the_fixed_check.result: 7 of 8 frozen prompts reproduced byte-identically; prompt 1 diverged (299 vs 261 reasoning chars). So the fixed check immediately surfaced real nondeterminism that the vacuous version could never see.
first_result_from_the_fixed_check.attribution_LIMIT: Measured under concurrent load, so the most likely cause is continuous-batching nondeterminism - batch composition changes reduction order and therefore logits - which is a known vLLM property and NOT a quantisation defect. This is NOT yet separated from engine-level nondeterminism at concurrency 1. A quiet-endpoint re-run is required before attributing, and until then no claim is made.

resume_command: once the 8x is free of production load: python3 ~/tb21_gate.py --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 --model qwen38 --skip-needle --out gate-repeat-quiet.json  (expect 8/8 if the divergence is purely batching)
standing_rule: A hash-equality check MUST assert that it hashed something. Any identity gate needs a vacuity guard, because an empty-vs-empty comparison is the most confident-looking false pass available.
